evidence.detail: Records installed package qgis-ltr 3.16.11-1 with archive packages-x86_64/qgis-ltr-3.16.11-1.tar.bz2.

Official OSGeo4W v1 x86_64 historical artifact identity: qgis-ltr-3.16.11-1.tar.bz2, 52875655 bytes, MD5 1381bb3caea7e557c4d6fe31eb765e71. The investigation read the official archive in memory and confirmed this size and checksum. MD5 is historical artifact-identity evidence, not a modern authenticity guarantee.
The identically named v2 x86_64 archive is distinct: 40103464 bytes, MD5 4c77d09b073f6b608f80f929fbf67f5f. It must not be substituted for the verified v1 artifact.

All 1546 retained package paths and sizes match the v1 archive. All listing timestamps match when interpreted in Europe/Berlin with the applicable DST offset. Retained-file comparison found 1428 byte-for-byte matches, two matches to the SHA-256 identities and sizes represented by local Git LFS pointers, and 36 differences limited to CRLF-to-LF conversion. These comparisons strongly identify the v1 archive as the source package; LFS identities are not upstream release checksums.

This retained file has substantive local differences from the v1 archive while retaining the same total size. Together with text line-ending changes, this means the checked-in tree is not a pristine byte-for-byte extraction. Verified status applies only to acquisition of this individual upstream package, not equivalence of the customized installed tree or reconstruction of the complete OSGeo4W package set and dependency closure.

Project archive lists the installer and its SHA-256 sidecar. This identifies the portable runtime distribution, not FHAST private R packages or local customizations.
Explicit application version 6.2.2.
Official release has no binary assets; directs binary acquisition to the CCL download site.
Official archive page identifies separate 32-bit and 64-bit Windows MSI downloads, including Java 8. The x86-64 MSI matches FHAST.

Artifact size 217914933 bytes. SHA-256 was calculated locally from bytes retrieved from the official NetLogo server; it is NOT an upstream-published checksum. Comparison of 3493 MSI payload files with 406 tracked FHAST files found 388 byte-identical files, four launcher files matching local Git LFS SHA-256 identities and sizes, and four line-ending-only differences. The only substantively changed shared file is app/NetLogo.cfg (-Xmx1024m to -Xmx8192m). FHAST adds nine pathdir extension files and omits 1804 documentation, 1213 model and 79 video-extension files. This verifies acquisition provenance of a customized subset, not a pristine extraction or complete runtime reconstruction.
Release notes record intentionally disabling the video extension, consistent with the payload comparison.

The verified parent MSI contains BellSoft Java 1.8.0_275-b01 (build corroborated by static sun/misc/Version.class data). Acquisition is through the parent MSI, not a standalone JRE artifact.
